name: @pipeworx/mcp-morocco-hcp-statistics

tools.name: ma_bulletins
tools.description: List the Moroccan Haut-Commissariat au Plan (HCP) quarterly statistical bulletins covered: title, quarter, publication date, how many indicator series parsed from each, plus the topic areas (prices, tourism, trade, labour, public finance, stock exchange, national accounts, ...). Start here for data_as_of and coverage.

tools.name: ma_indicators
tools.description: Search Morocco's national economic and social indicators from the HCP quarterly bulletin (monthly and quarterly series: consumer and producer price indexes by city, industrial/mining/energy output, tourism nights, external trade, exchange rates, public finances, Casablanca stock exchange, labour force, national accounts). Accepts French or English terms ("inflation", "indice general", "tourisme", "chomage", "euro"); optional topic filter. Returns ids with latest value; call ma_indicator_series for history. With no arguments lists the topics.

search.description: Words from the indicator name, French or English, e.g. "indice general", "inflation", "nuitees", "euro". All words must match.

topic.description: Optional topic filter (substring), e.g. "IPC", "Tourisme", "COMMERCE EXTERIEUR", "FINANCES PUBLIQUES". Listed by ma_bulletins.

tools.name: ma_indicator_series
tools.description: Time series for one Moroccan HCP indicator by id (from ma_indicators): every period with its value, latest value, and the change vs the previous period and vs a year earlier. Optional from/to as YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or a bare year. A miss returns found:false with data_as_of and nearby ids.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-morocco-hcp-statistics forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the morocco-hcp-statistics pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
